title: Preparation from the Initial Configuration
statement: For every $l\in\mathbb{N}$ and every Boolean input word $x$, there is a time $t\le 2|x|+3$ at which the preparation machine started on $x$ reaches the loader entry configuration: its field tapes are blank, its stream tape contains $x$ with its head at position zero, its input head is at position $1$, its loader counter is zero, and its output is empty.
replaced: For every field count $l$ and input word $x$, there is a time $t \le 2|x| + 3$ after which the preparation machine, started from its own native initial configuration with no assumed work-tape words, sits at the row loader's entry: all field targets blank, the stream holding exactly $x$ with cursor zero, and both heads canonical.
